items.source: Maps an object to a BytesMessage, or to a TextMessage if the targetType is set to MessageType.TEXT. Converts from a TextMessage or BytesMessage to an object.
items.translation: 将对象映射到 `BytesMessage`，或者如果 `targetType` 设置为 `MessageType.TEXT`，则映射到 `TextMessage`。将 `TextMessage` 或 `BytesMessage` 转换为对象。

items.source: The default is MessageType.BYTES, i.e. this converter marshals to a BytesMessage. Note that the default version of this converter supports MessageType.BYTES and MessageType.TEXT only.
items.translation: 默认值为 `MessageType.BYTES`，即此转换器会转换为`BytesMessage`。请注意，此转换器的默认版本仅支持 `MessageType.BYTES` 和 `MessageType.TEXT`。

items.source: The default implementation throws an IllegalArgumentException.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出一个IllegalArgumentException。

items.source: Default is none. NOTE: This property needs to be set in order to allow for converting from an incoming message to a Java object.
items.translation: 默认值为无。注意：必须设置此属性，才能允许将传入消息转换为 Java 对象。

items.source:
When reading from a text-based message, an encoding may have been
suggested through a special JMS property which will then be preferred
over the encoding set on this MessageConverter instance.
items.translation: 从基于文本的消息读取时，可能会通过特殊的 JMS 属性建议一种编码，该编码将优先于在此 MessageConverter 实例上设置的编码。

items.source:
Default is none. Setting this property is optional; if not set, UTF-8 will
be used for decoding any incoming bytes message.
items.translation: 默认值为无。设置此属性是可选的；如果不设置，将使用 UTF-8 对任何传入的字节消息进行解码。

items.source: Default is no custom mappings, i.e. transferring raw Java class names.
items.translation: 默认情况下没有自定义映射，即直接传递原始的 Java 类名。

items.source:
The default implementation consults the configured type id mapping and
sets the resulting value (either a mapped id or the raw Java class name)
into the configured type id message property.
items.translation: 默认实现会查询配置的类型 ID 映射，并将结果值（即映射后的 ID 或原始 Java 类名）设置到配置的类型 ID 消息属性中。

items.source:
The default implementation parses the configured type id property name
and consults the configured type id mapping. This can be overridden with
a different strategy, for example, doing some heuristics based on message origin.
items.translation: 默认实现会解析配置的类型 ID 属性名，并查询配置的类型 ID 映射。可以通过不同的策略覆盖此行为，例如基于消息来源执行某些启发式算法。

items.source: Specify whether toMessage(Object, Session) should marshal to a BytesMessage or a TextMessage.
items.translation: 指定 `toMessage(Object, Session)` 应将其转换为 `BytesMessage` 还是 `TextMessage`。

items.source: Construct a new instance with a JsonMapper customized with the JacksonModules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader).
items.translation: 使用 `MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader)` 找到的 `JacksonModule` 自定义的 `JsonMapper` 构建一个新实例。

items.source: Construct a new instance with the provided JsonMapper.Builder customized with the JacksonModules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader).
items.translation: 使用 `MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader)` 查找到的 `JacksonModule` 对提供的 `JsonMapper.Builder` 进行自定义，并构建一个新实例。
